description: Synteny-anchored scan: best ungapped identity to Vam10p in any antisense frame of each VPS5 ortholog across 15 Saccharomycetaceae species, against a shuffled-query null
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
bases="TCAG"; aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={}; i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases:
            CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i]; i+=1
tr=lambda s:"".join(CODON.get(s[k:k+3].upper(),"X") for k in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
COMP=str.maketrans("ACGTacgt","TGCAtgca"); rc=lambda s:s.translate(COMP)[::-1]
VAM10="MLFEVFGEVLASYIVSSKTKGELAFPVNNAPPDSLVAINCVVLFLRSAIGSCSGAKELIRSSALELSCSSSCGLPATDKPGSFHSGALSKSILSANEAVVSKSSLSFLSSFVDI"
L=len(VAM10); Q=np.frombuffer(VAM10.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)

def jget(url, params=None, tries=5, raw=False):
    for a in range(tries):
        try:
            r=requests.get(url,params=params,timeout=90)
            if r.status_code==200: return r.text if raw else r.json()
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(1.5+1.5*a)
    return None
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"

o=jget("https://api.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/v2alpha/gene/id/854235/orthologs",
       {"returned_content":"COMPLETE","page_size":400})
by_tax={g["gene"].get("taxname"): g["gene"].get("gene_id") for g in o["reports"]}
PANEL=[("Saccharomyces cerevisiae","S. cerevisiae","Saccharomyces"),
 ("Saccharomyces paradoxus","S. paradoxus","Saccharomyces"),
 ("Saccharomyces mikatae","S. mikatae","Saccharomyces"),
 ("Saccharomyces kudriavzevii","S. kudriavzevii","Saccharomyces"),
 ("Saccharomyces eubayanus","S. eubayanus","Saccharomyces"),
 ("Naumovozyma","Naumovozyma sp.","post-WGD, non-Saccharomyces"),
 ("Kazachstania","Kazachstania sp.","post-WGD, non-Saccharomyces"),
 ("Nakaseomyces","Nakaseomyces glabratus","post-WGD, non-Saccharomyces"),
 ("Tetrapisispora","Tetrapisispora sp.","post-WGD, non-Saccharomyces"),
 ("Kluyveromyces lactis","K. lactis","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 ("Kluyveromyces marxianus","K. marxianus","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 ("Lachancea","Lachancea sp.","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 ("Eremothecium","E. gossypii","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 ("Zygosaccharomyces","Zygosaccharomyces rouxii","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 ("Torulaspora","Torulaspora delbrueckii","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae")]
seqs={}
for m,lab,clade in PANEL:
    hit=[t for t in by_tax if t and t.startswith(m)]
    if not hit: continue
    g=by_tax[hit[0]]
    s=jget(E+"esummary.fcgi",{"db":"gene","id":str(g),"retmode":"json"})
    try: gi=s["result"][str(g)]["genomicinfo"][0]
    except Exception: continue
    a,b=int(gi["chrstart"]),int(gi["chrstop"]); lo,hi=min(a,b)+1,max(a,b)+1
    nt=jget(E+"efetch.fcgi",{"db":"nuccore","id":gi["chraccver"],"rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text",
           "seq_start":lo,"seq_stop":hi,"strand":1 if b>a else 2},raw=True)
    if not nt or ">" not in nt: continue
    sq="".join(nt.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
    if len(sq)>900: seqs[lab]=(sq,clade)
    time.sleep(0.4)
print("species:",len(seqs))

def best_ident(anti_prots, query_arr):
    best=(0.0,None,None)
    for fi,p in enumerate(anti_prots):
        P=np.frombuffer(p.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)
        if len(P)<L: continue
        W=np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(P,L)
        ident=(W==query_arr).sum(1)/L
        k=int(ident.argmax())
        if ident[k]>best[0]: best=(float(ident[k]),fi,k)
    return best

rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
shuf=[np.frombuffer("".join(rng.permutation(list(VAM10))).encode(),dtype=np.uint8) for _ in range(30)]

rows=[]
for lab,(sq,clade) in seqs.items():
    r=rc(sq)
    anti=[tr(r[f:]) for f in range(3)]
    obs,fi,k=best_ident(anti,Q)
    nulls=[best_ident(anti,s)[0] for s in shuf]
    mu,sd=float(np.mean(nulls)),float(np.std(nulls))
    z=(obs-mu)/sd if sd>0 else float("nan")
    # stop codons in the VAM10-equivalent window of the best frame
    win=anti[fi][k:k+L] if fi is not None else ""
    rows.append(dict(sp=lab,clade=clade,obs=100*obs,null=100*mu,nullsd=100*sd,z=z,
                     stops=win.count("*"),nmax=100*max(nulls)))
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
ORD=["Saccharomyces","post-WGD, non-Saccharomyces","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"]
df["o"]=df.clade.map({c:i for i,c in enumerate(ORD)}); df=df.sort_values(["o","obs"],ascending=[True,False])
pd.set_option("display.width",200)
print(df[["sp","clade","obs","null","nullsd","nmax","z","stops"]].to_string(index=False,
      float_format=lambda x:f"{x:7.2f}"))

COL={"Saccharomyces":"#ddaa33","post-WGD, non-Saccharomyces":"#4477aa","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae":"#888888"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5))
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,df.obs,color=[COL[c] for c in df.clade],edgecolor="black",lw=0.6,height=0.68)
ax.errorbar(df.null,y,xerr=2*df.nullsd,fmt="o",color="black",ms=4,lw=1.2,capsize=3,
            label="shuffled-query null, mean $\\pm$ 2 SD")
for yy,st,ob in zip(y,df.stops,df.obs):
    if st: ax.text(ob+0.7,yy,f"{st} stop"+("s" if st>1 else ""),va="center",fontsize=8,color="#aa3333")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(df.sp,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("best ungapped identity to S. cerevisiae Vam10p (%), any antisense frame of the VPS5 ortholog")
ax.set_title("Vam10p similarity survives only inside Saccharomyces sensu stricto",fontsize=11)
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=COL[c],ec="black",lw=0.6) for c in ORD]
ax.legend(h+[plt.Line2D([],[],marker="o",color="black",lw=1.2)],ORD+["shuffled-query null, mean $\\pm$ 2 SD"],
          loc="lower right",fontsize=8.5,frameon=True)
ax.set_xlim(0,max(df.obs)*1.18)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
